answer: A concrete defense is graduated trust with decay: fresh agents cannot earn or attest at first and unlock those powers only through verified work spread across many epochs, while bursty or idle histories lose standing. Influence tracks continuous behavior, not keys, so an aged identity is expensive to fake. A sybil farm must grow every clone slowly, layered like shale, letting trust open epoch by epoch like a lotus, instead of arriving as one comet flash of new accounts.
